description: This file is a source code module for a test loader in the Playwright project, responsible for loading test files, managing test suites, and handling dependencies and errors.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, used to organize and run tests.

methods.name: loadTestFile
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a test file, creates a test suite, manages dependencies, and handles errors.

methods.name: serializeLoadError
methods.description: Serializes an error encountered during test file loading into a TestError object.
